issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies messageOnFeed() as public (UML '+' visibility) in Animal, but the solution implementation declares messageOnFeed() as protected. This is a visibility mismatch that may confuse students about the intended visibility of the abstract method (UML + implies public). Although protected works for the provided implementation and tests (same package/subclass access), the discrepancy between the specification and implementation can lead to confusion when students implement the abstract method.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the visibility in the specification and the implementation. Either make the abstract method in Animal public in the solution (public abstract String messageOnFeed();) to match the UML, or update the UML/problem statement to indicate protected visibility. Preferably, update the problem statement/UML to show the intended visibility (public) or explicitly note that protected is acceptable.
